title: Connectors
transfer: Traffic goes from the coding agent straight to the service; Atlas is not in the middle and its transfer log does not record it.
authority: A token that can write lets the agent change that service; every call still stops at your permission card.
runtimeNarrowing: Connectors ride Claude sessions. Codex has not been measured for this yet, so a Codex session gets the folder's own server and nothing else.
noFolderBody: Connectors are written into the folder you open. Open it, then attach one.
scanning: Reading what this computer already registers.
discoveryFailed: Could not read what is already registered on this computer. You can still add one by hand, and a name already in use here cannot be flagged.
searchPlaceholder: A name, a command, an address
catalogueMeta: As of {date}. Only what attaches in the app; the app fetches nothing.
customToggle: Not in the list? Add it by hand
noneForSearchBody: A server that is not listed can still be added by hand, with its name and how it runs.
asksOauthShort: the in-app session cannot open the sign-in window
removeConfirmBody: The row leaves this folder’s connector list. Nothing else on this computer changes.
removeConfirmBodyKeys: The row leaves this folder’s connector list, and these values are deleted from this computer’s keychain: {keys}. There is no way to read them back.
rowTransfer: Once on, the agent talks to {destination} directly.
rowTransferStdio: Once on, this runs on your computer, and whatever it reaches it reaches from there. Atlas is not in between.
collision: This machine already registers a server called {name}. Codex drops a second one under that name without saying so. Rename this one.
malformed: {path} could not be read, so nothing here can be saved. Open that file and fix or delete it.
plaintext: {path} holds a token in plain text ({keys}). Enter it below to move it into this machine's keychain; the next save removes the plain text.
foundNone: No MCP server is registered anywhere this app can read.
foundUnsupported: This is an {transport} server, and neither coding agent accepts that transport any more.
valueNotInFile: A value under this name is never written to the file. Turn the keychain on to enter it.
secretMissing: No value on this machine yet. The connector will not start without it.
secretsWeb: This connector needs a value for {keys}. Keeping it needs the desktop app.
customBody: For a server that is not registered anywhere yet.

addFailReason.malformed: the connector file in that folder could not be read
addFailReason.secret: a token would have been written in plain text

fieldCommandHint: The full path. The agent runs without a PATH, so a bare name like npx finds nothing.
fieldKeysHint: Names only. A value that looks like a credential goes in the keychain, never in the file.
fieldKeysHintWeb: Names only. Keeping a value needs the desktop app.
webTitle: Finding what is already registered needs the desktop app
webBody: Reading ~/.claude.json or ~/.codex/config.toml needs a program running on this computer, and there is nowhere on this surface to keep a token. Adding a connector by hand still works, and the list is written into your folder.

problem.name-not-unique: Another connector already uses this name.
problem.command-not-absolute: Write the full path: the agent runs without a PATH.
problem.url-not-http: The address has to start with http:// or https://.
problem.secret-literal: A token is written in plain text; move it into the keychain first.
problem.value-missing: A variable is set to come from the keychain and there is nothing behind it yet.

variantAsksOauth: This address needs a sign-in, and the in-app session cannot open that window (measured 2026-09-07). Attach it in your coding tool in the terminal instead.
variantAsksToken: Asks you for one value: {keys}. It goes into this machine’s keychain, never into the folder’s file.
customFromCatalogue: Filled in from the list for {title}, captured {date}. Check the line below before you add it: that is what will run.
variablesNone: None. Add one if this server needs a token or a setting.
variableSecret: Keep this value in this machine’s keychain
emptyBody: A connector lets the agent you talk to in Atlas also reach a service you already use: your Notion pages, your Jira issues, your repositories. Add one and it stays off until you turn it on.
linkDroppedValues: That link carried values for {keys}. They were dropped: a link never sets a token. Type it below instead.
linkRefused: That link was refused ({reason}). Nothing was added.

catalogueSummary.notion: Read and write the pages and databases in your Notion account.
catalogueSummary.github: Read and write issues, pull requests, code and wikis on GitHub.
catalogueSummary.playwright: Open web pages and navigate, click, type and read through accessibility snapshots.
catalogueSummary.context7: Current, version-specific documentation and code examples for a library.

attachedToast: {name} is attached and off. Switch it on when you want the agent to use it.
